Name: Neck,Head
Description: This will create a Neck and a Head System

attrs.Help_string:
Overview:
  This will create a Neck and a Head System.

How To Use:
  fill the key fields below before build.

Fields:
- SetParent: set the target node name.
- If left as default, the tool uses placeholder behavior for setup.
- HeadCtrlType: choose one option (for example: octagon, hexagon, square, sphere).
- Ribbon: turn this ON/OFF depending on whether you want that feature.
- SecundaryRibbon: numeric value that controls size/amount/intensity (default 3).
- CtrlSize: numeric value that controls size/amount/intensity (default 4).
- CtrlColor: choose one option (for example: yellow, lightBlue, blue, white).
- Template parent examples: Head_Jnt, L_Hand_Ankle_Jnt, Head_Ctrl.

Tips:
- if a field says left/right or mirror, use it to generate the opposite side quickly.
